sections.name: Unarmed Idle
sections.description: Frames 0-10: his EMPTY-HANDED fight stance (no machete in any of them, checked). The supplied 'end' section. Ping-ponged so the loop has no seam. Used only while he does not own the machete.

sections.name: Unarmed Hit
sections.description: The supplied 'Aye-unarmed-hit-reaction' (11-15): he snaps back on 14-15. The sheet carries no return frames (16 is already the fall), so 14-13 are played back out of it to land him on his stance instead of popping from the lean.

sections.name: Fall Air
sections.description: First half of the supplied 'Aye-fall' (16-28): knocked off his feet and going over. Plays while the sim has him airborne and holds 22 for a long flight.

sections.name: Fall Down
sections.description: Second half of 'Aye-fall': the crash, ending flat on his back on 28. 6 frames at 24fps = 0.25s — AYE_FALLDOWN_DUR in game.js is this number.

sections.name: Get Up
sections.description: The artist's own 'Aye-getup' selection out of the 29-52 rise, IN PLAYING ORDER. The supplied section lists [0..10, 29, 30, ...] — sorted ascending, so read literally it would play his standing stance FIRST and then lie down to rise. The sheet's start/end roles say the true order: start = 29-52 (the rise), end = 0-10 (the stance he rises into). The end is left to the stance loop that follows. 13 frames at 30fps = 0.433s — AYE_GETUP_DUR.

sections.name: Death Air
sections.description: First half of the supplied 'Aye-die' (53-71): the blow that kills him, and going over.

sections.name: Death Down
sections.description: Second half of 'Aye-die': he lands and ends face down and still on 69-71, then holds.

sections.name: Weapon Pickup
sections.description: Bending for his dropped machete: the upper end of the get-up rise (52 upright -> 44 crouched, hand at the road) played BACKWARDS, so he goes down to it. 6 frames at 20fps = 0.30s — WEAPON_RECOVERY.reach. Ownership transfers on the last frame; the rise back up is armed art (shaved-agbero-sharpen pickupRise).

note: ALL 72 FRAMES ARE UNARMED. This sheet is only correct for an Aye who does not hold the machete, which is why game.js drops the weapon (dropMachete) at the knockdown event before any of these sections can be drawn. Art faces LEFT like every other sheet of him (he snaps back toward +x when hit and lands head toward +x).
